chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
Conduct the procession of your brides at night, and feed [your guests] in the forenoon.
ai.seo_question: What are the recommended times for wedding processions and feeding guests according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) prescribes holding the bride's procession at night and serving food during the forenoon, reflecting the Shia emphasis on joy, privacy, and communal sharing in marital unions. This guidance aligns with the Prophetic tradition of celebrating marriage as a Sunnah, distinguishing it from solemn rituals by encouraging festivity and generosity. The timing specifics highlight the cultural adaptability of Shia jurisprudence while maintaining core values of modesty and social bonding.
